name: Squall Bindcord
description: Begin with a thrust whose lead hand and lead foot move together and whose rear pair follows.

name: Squall Longshaft
description: Slip a thrust with a parry made by both hands moving as a pair along the shaft.

name: Squall Leafhead
description: Chase a retreating opponent with paired steps that keep both feet and both hands in rhythm.

name: Ferrule Troth
description: Beat an opposing haft with one hand while the other readies the thrust.

name: Quenched Beatback
description: Send two thrusts in a paired rhythm, the second following before the guard answers the first.

name: Circling Spearpoint
description: Circle the point along an imagined rim to cover the body against thrusts from different heights.

name: Splendid Pushthrough
description: Drop the point from a high hold while the rear pair of the stance drives forward.

name: Destiny Stretch
description: Seek an opening by trying two tracks of thrust in turn and driving the point down the second.

name: Prismspear
description: Return a counter-thrust along the path of the opponent's own strike with the paired force of both hands.

name: Inferno Bladewings
description: The school's opening move, a paired thrust that begins the exchange with both hands and both feet in a single motion.

name: Magnificent Bladewings
description: Jab the point along its own track straight at the opponent's centre.

name: Masterful Longshaft
description: Beat along the haft track across an opposing shaft to knock it off line.

name: Dustpoint
description: Glide on two lines of footwork, one forward and one to the side, and arrive at the flank.

name: Imperious Slideshaft
description: Press with point and haft in alternation until the opponent's guard has no safe line.

name: Destiny Collarband
description: Strike with the haft and follow immediately with the point on the same line.

name: Pall Leafhead
description: Turn the shaft across both tracks of an attack and carry it off the body.

name: Storied Heelspike
description: Press the point along one track while the haft presses on the other until the guard breaks.

name: Twirldecree
description: Pour out strikes along both tracks in a rolling sequence that drives the opponent back a pace at a time.

name: Thrustbanner
description: Close a gap in one lunge on the point track while the haft track holds the guard open.

name: Seasonspear
description: Run a high strike on one track and a low strike on the other so every guard raised opens the other line.

name: Sovereign Quenched Heelspike
description: The school's meeting move, in which point and haft arrive at the same instant along two tracks and break one guard.

name: Squall Ferrule
description: Hold the point high from a narrow stance and ready to drop on an opening.

name: Sainted Spearpoint
description: Spread the stance low and flat with the shaft across the knees against sweeping attacks.

name: Twirlgrace
description: Slide from the high stance to the low in one flowing step.

name: Gallant Stretch
description: Reach out from the perch with the point and strike at the guarding hand.

name: Paramount Pushthrough
description: Drop from the high hold onto the target's shoulder in a single stab.

name: Vigor Beatback
description: Sweep a low circle with the shaft from the basin stance to strike the shins.

name: Pallsocket
description: Show the high stance and change to the low as the opponent commits.

name: Buttshoe Troth
description: Press from above and below at once to close the opponent's room to move.

name: Seasonpoint
description: Swoop from the high hold, rebound off the low stance and strike a second time from below.

name: Thunderclap Bindcord
description: Rise from the lowest point of the stance into a climbing thrust under the opponent's guard.

name: Pointcrown
description: Sweep the haft overhead and down in a hawk's dive to strike all within the spear's reach.

name: Tenetsocket
description: The school's twin-stance move, a strike that begins in the high hawk stance and finishes in the low basin stance.

name: Steel Beatback
description: Start the thrust at the lead hand like a river from its source and send it forward.

name: Majestic Buttshoe
description: Follow the lead hand's thrust with the rear hand's drive to carry the point further in.

name: Evanescent Slideshaft
description: Slip along the opponent's flank like a river hugging its bank.

name: Millstone Stretch
description: Wind the shaft along the opposing haft in a river's turns to lead it away.

name: Twirltriumph
description: Cut down in quick, rapids-like drives that follow one another on the same line.

name: Peal Collarband
description: Slide both hands along the shaft together to parry with the lead and follow with the rear.

name: Thunderclap Bladewings
description: Bend the thrust around a guard in a river's curve and pierce the side beyond.

name: Thrustedict
description: Flood the opponent with rapid thrusts from each hand in turn that rise like a spate.

name: Spearcrown
description: Branch the shaft's strikes into many streams that spread out like a river delta.

name: Vaunted Leafhead
description: The school's course move, a thrust sent by the lead hand and followed by the rear along one continuous river line.

name: Valiant Spearpoint
description: Concentrate the field at the spearhead and jab so the point strikes with its full force.

name: Pointpledge
description: Concentrate the field at the butt and beat an opposing haft aside with it.

name: Skyborne Ferrule
description: Slide the stance on the field so one point guards while the other waits.

name: Prism Longshaft
description: Reverse the shaft to strike with the butt's field after the spearhead has drawn the guard.

name: Thrustpledge
description: Bind an opposing weapon between the two points of the field in the manner of a vice.

name: Faithful Bindcord
description: Parry with the edge of the field so that blows are caught before touching the wood.

name: Twirlverdict
description: Chain a thrust with the spearhead and a thrust with the butt without turning the shaft.

name: Pulsar Pushthrough
description: Whirl the shaft between the two points of the field and thrust through the opposing guard.

name: Prism Heelspike
description: Stand with one point at each end of the shaft to guard against blows from both fronts.

name: Peal Slideshaft
description: Strike the opponent's guard with both points at once to split it apart.

name: Illustrious Thrust Verdict
description: The school's closing move, a thrust in which both points of the field strike the same target at the same moment.

name: Socketcrown
description: Draw the core's qi upward and thrust along the rising line toward the sky.

name: Royal Beatback
description: Draw the core's qi downward and strike along the falling line toward the ground.

name: Deluge Spearpoint
description: Pivot with a guard that holds one point in the sky and one on the ground.

name: Buttshoe Solace
description: Seat the weight at the core and glide across a gap with the spear held level.

name: Steelspear
description: Drive a jab from the core through the arms and shaft in a tight beam.

name: Custody Bindcord
description: Wheel the shaft between a sky guard and a ground guard to parry any height.

name: Ferrule Triumph
description: Press the opponent with a chain of high and low thrusts that alternate like day and night.

name: Lordly Leafhead
description: Counter from a high hold with a drop along the same line the opponent has taken.

name: Pushthrough Verdict
description: Surge the core's qi into a thrust that pierces the guard from the sky line and the ground line together.

name: Matchless Longshaft
description: Sweep the shaft overhead and down in a broad dome, striking all within the stance's reach.

name: Season Bladewings
description: Cross a high thrust and a low thrust over the opponent's guard so that both land at one moment.

name: Intrepid Vacuum Slideshaft
description: The school's closing move, a thrust that strikes from both sky and ground in the same instant with the core's whole force.

name: Triumphant Stretch
description: Speak the oath of the line in the mind and thrust along it without turning.

name: Consecrated Collarband
description: Plant the feet and parry with the shaft, holding the stance against the wind's push.

name: Deluge Heelspike
description: Run the plateau's long pace forward with the point held out before the body.

name: Peal Heelspike
description: Beat an opposing shaft with the wind's weight and press the point onto the open line.

name: Vigorspear
description: Counter an attack by thrusting along the oath-line without leaving it.

name: Steel Leafhead
description: Bend the haft like a tree in a gale to catch a heavy strike and let it slide.

name: Socketbanner
description: Sweep a thrust through the wind to arrive at the target before the guard has set.

name: Season Longshaft
description: Hold the oath through three thrusts in succession, never leaving the line once drawn.

name: Gloompoint
description: Hold the sworn line against several opponents until each gives ground one by one.

name: Fearless Prism Buttshoe
description: The school's oath move, a thrust sworn before it is made and held on its line against any parry.

name: Bountiful Buttshoe
description: Take the bearing of the opponent from a still stance and set the point on it.

name: Twirlcrown
description: Jab along the plateau line with the shaft level and the weight settled.

name: Ethereal Pushthrough
description: Step aside while the point remains on its bearing so the line is not lost.

name: Bladewings Seal
description: Check a blow with the shaft held across the front on open ground.

name: Vacuum Spearpoint
description: Correct the bearing by a hand's breadth mid-thrust and pierce the guard turned to the old one.

name: Tyrannous Bindcord
description: Hold the opposing haft on the plateau against the wind and keep the bearing fixed.

name: Volition Stretch
description: Chase on a bearing across open ground with thrusts that follow the retreat.

name: Peal Beatback
description: Hold the bearing against a rush and wedge the shaft into the opponent's hands.

name: Quenched Slideshaft
description: Charge along a held bearing and drive the point through at the end of the run.

name: Millstone Collarband
description: Stand on the true line and press with the point until the opponent's guard weakens.

name: Dauntless Ferrule
description: Hold the bearing through every attempt to turn it and thrust through the guard without leaving the line.

name: Peerless Collarband
description: The school's bearing move, a thrust held on one fixed bearing from the first step to the point's arrival.

name: Thrustcrown
description: Thrust in the open with nothing behind and the oath's line held before the body.

name: Undefiled Buttshoe
description: Guard against any quarter with the shaft held out, trusting no back or cover.

name: Dustsocket
description: Time a forward step with a gust at the back so the point arrives sooner.

name: Commanding Heelspike
description: Beat an opposing haft on a slant that the gale turns into a cutting blow.

name: Ferrule Banner
description: Send two thrusts along the sworn line, the second following before the first has withdrawn.

name: Longshaft Seal
description: Turn the haft in the open wind so strikes slide from the shaft with no purchase.

name: Gloomtwirl
description: Press in with the gale at the back to drive the opponent from the ground.

name: Thrusttriumph
description: Lunge with the whole force of the oath and the gale and pierce a braced guard.

name: Spearverdict
description: Sweep the shaft in a gust that clears the ground before the stance of all opposition.

name: Pointdecree
description: Chain thrusts, beats and sweeps in an oath-sworn sequence that never leaves the open ground.

name: Exalted Socket Decree
description: The school's open-ground move, a thrust sworn in the gale and delivered with no cover and nothing held back.

name: Spearedict
description: Run the wind down the line of the shaft and thrust at the opponent's centre.

name: Parity Bladewings
description: Pin the feet in the oath of the stance and brace the shaft against a rush.

name: Deluge Beatback
description: Drift sideways while the point keeps its line on the opponent.

name: Imperial Bindcord
description: Probe the guard with quick jabs tempered by the wind's changing push.

name: Sigil Pushthrough
description: Bind the opposing haft along the oath-line and turn it from its owner's grip.

name: Bedrock Spearpoint
description: Hold the haft in a windbreak across the front to scatter several strikes.

name: Noble Leafhead
description: Lunge down the line with the wind's weight added to the thrust.

name: Volition Slideshaft
description: Run down the line in a series of thrusts, each landing a pace beyond the last.

name: Twirledict
description: Run the wind and the oath down the line together into a single thrust that no parry turns.

name: Famed Stretch
description: The school's line move, a thrust in which wind and oath travel along one line to a single point of impact.

name: Heroic Stretch
description: Hold the bearing against a gale and thrust along it with the field filling the shaft.

name: Parity Leafhead
description: Root the stance in the field so no blow can move the feet.

name: Reminiscence Bladewings
description: Read the gale's push on the field and shift the footing before it rises.

name: Statute Longshaft
description: Press the field along the fixed bearing so the opposing weapon is held from rising.

name: Valiant Beatback
description: Split the gale and the guard together along a narrow line of qi.

name: Imperial Pushthrough
description: Hold the bearing through a counter and drive the point in as the counter spends itself.

name: Catching Collarband
description: Turn the haft against the gale so strikes are caught on the field and let go.

name: Vacuum Bindcord
description: Anchor the bearing and charge into the opponent with the gale driving the point.

name: Tempestuous Ferrule
description: Sweep the field in a scouring arc that clears the space before the stance.

name: Resonant Spearpoint
description: Hold the bearing through a chain of thrusts that each drive harder as the gale rises.

name: Buttshoe Banner
description: The school's held-bearing move, a thrust that keeps its bearing unbroken through the gale and drives through any guard.

name: Pointbanner
description: Face the wind and send the core's qi down the shaft in a thrust at the opponent.

name: Inviolate Heelspike
description: Take a wide stance in open country with the shaft held out in guard across the front.

name: Squall Slideshaft
description: Lighten the body with the core's qi and stride along the wind.

name: Inferno Slideshaft
description: Reach the point out to the edge of its range and jab at the guarding hand.

name: Sockettriumph
description: Gather the core's qi and the wind together into a narrow drive of the point.

name: Immaculate Longshaft
description: Turn the haft in a parry that needs no wall behind it, catching blows on a field of core qi.

name: Thrusttroth
description: Beat against the opposing haft from the windward side and press the point onto the open line.

name: Season Twirl
description: Chase the retreating opponent across open country with thrusts timed to the wind.

name: Exalted Bindcord
description: Rush into the opponent with the core's qi driving the point through a braced guard.

name: Tempestuous Bladewings
description: Sweep the shaft in an open-sky arc that scatters all opposition within the spear's reach.

name: Choral Pushthrough
description: Run a long series of thrusts, beats and sweeps across open ground with nothing held in reserve.

name: Unrivaled Collarband Verdict
description: The school's windward move, a thrust delivered in open country with the core's whole force and no shelter behind.
